$comment: Suggested caption and alt text per shot slug. {{placeholders}} are filled from the run's config; {{blockType}} falls back to 'the selected block'.

editor-shell.caption: The P1 editor showing {{pagePath}} with the Blocks panel, canvas, and properties panel.
editor-shell.alt: P1 editor with the header at the top, the Blocks panel on the left, the page preview in the center, and page properties on the right.

blocks-browser.caption: The Blocks panel with all categories expanded.
blocks-browser.alt: Blocks panel listing block categories, with the {{blockCategory}} group open and its blocks shown.

block-selected-properties.caption: A selected block and its properties.
block-selected-properties.alt: {{blockType}} selected in the canvas, with its name and options in the properties panel on the right.

block-selected-canvas-context.caption: The same block with the Blocks panel collapsed for a wider canvas.
block-selected-canvas-context.alt: {{blockType}} still selected, the left Blocks panel collapsed to an icon rail, and the page preview filling the extra width.

workstream-selector-open.caption: Choosing a workstream.
workstream-selector-open.alt: The workstream selector open, listing the available workstreams, with a search field above the list.

publish-menu-open.caption: The More actions menu, including the publish option.
publish-menu-open.alt: The More actions menu open under the primary button, listing {{publishMenuLabel}} and other page actions.
